competing_explanation: The policy may have changed, standard items may be excluded, or the 30-day window may apply only to exchanges or store credit rather than full refunds.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy for standard items provides a 30-day full-refund return window, measured from the date of delivery.
predicted_outcome: H_R is supported: the correct current window is 30 days for full refunds on standard items.
refutation_criterion: Counterfactual evidence shows the current standard-item full-refund window is not 30 days, that full refunds are unavailable within 30 days, or that the window is defined in a materially different way.
